newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices mixed at auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices mixed at auction.

text.p: Tea prices were mixed on reduced demand at the weekly Kenya tea auction held in Mombasa on Monday, auction officials said.

Brighter BP1s eased by 3-8 U.S cents. Brighter PF1s shed 2-7 cents while mediums held firm. Brightest PDUSTs were a strong feature, appreciating by 2-4 cents, while other brighter sorts were irregular.
Fannings and BMFs were generally dearer.
Pakistan and Egypt were active but less forceful while there was strong enquiry from the Sudan, Yemen.
